purpose: Test steering loss balance after recovery sampling failed physical evaluation. No driving improvement is claimed.

basis.choice: Smallest tested multiplier giving positive steering alignment in all eight fixed-state batch measurements.
basis.limits: A local gradient-direction probe does not predict AdamW updates or physical driving.

selection.rules: Existing offline retention and checkpoint selection rules remain unchanged.

additional_imitation_gate.anchors: First stored qualified recovery anchor in each of the eight frozen training episodes; zero to 0.15 seconds after handoff.
additional_imitation_gate.comparison: Actual requested PlanPurePursuit steering versus recorded native teacher request.
additional_imitation_gate.device: CPU FP32 with the same native temporal inputs used by the recorded diagnostic.
additional_imitation_gate.scope: Seen-anchor learning check only, not a safety or generalization claim.
additional_imitation_gate.failure_action: Reject this candidate without physical promotion. Do not relax these limits.

physical_evaluation: Only after offline selection, the additional imitation check, and saved-input inference checks pass. Exposed track and skidpad comparisons precede all frozen fresh tests.
